question: What praise is attributed to Śatadrukā by a multitude of the good?
premises: She is sung by a hundred good ones
The verse expresses wonder at this praise
inference: The goddess Śatadrukā is wondrously praised here by many good beings.
uncertainties: katham may be read as exclamatory rather than interrogative
plain_english: How that goddess Śatadrukā is sung here by a hundred good ones!
